_comment: Base config for diff-scoped mutation testing. The `mutate` array is NOT set here — it is injected dynamically by `scripts/stryker-changed-files.ts` (which scopes Stryker to the .ts/.tsx files changed in the PR) into a generated `stryker.run.json`. Run via `bun run mutation:diff`, not `stryker run` directly.

commandRunner._comment: There is no native Stryker test runner for `bun test` (no @stryker-mutator/bun-runner exists on npm). The built-in `command` runner wraps an arbitrary shell command and infers pass/fail from the exit code, spawning a fresh process per mutant with the active-mutant id in the env. Consequence: coverageAnalysis MUST be 'off' (the command runner reports no per-test coverage, so perTest is unavailable). The command runs the FULL unit suite (mirrors `test:unit` / coverage-gate.yml, excludes integration tests that need a relay) for every mutant — slower than perTest but correct, and bounded by the changed-files scope. Override with STRYKER_TEST_COMMAND env if you want a targeted subset.
commandRunner.command: bun test $(find contextvm src/queries/__tests__ src/lib/__tests__ scripts -type f -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.integration.test.ts' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')
